links.outcome: LLM FIM estimate error versus modal-score and LOCF baselines
links.effect: LLM outperformed the modal-score baseline but had a higher MAE than the LOCF overall (0.825 vs 0.648).
links.quote: The LLM outperformed the modal-score baseline but had a higher MAE than the LOCF overall (0.825 vs 0.648).

links.outcome: LLM accuracy on local historical notes against reference FIM scores
links.effect: Of 57,246 estimable note-item pairs with same-day reference, 77.7% (44,481) were within 1 point; only 33.5% were estimable.
links.quote: Among 170,744 note-item opportunities with an available same-day reference score, 57,246 (33.5%) were estimable, of which 77.7% (44,481/57,246) were within 1 point of the reference score.

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the performance of a zero-shot LLM in estimating Functional Independence Measure scores from clinical notes compared to reference scores without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
